productions.title: Les Misérables
productions.description: A sweeping epic of love, sacrifice, and redemption set against the turmoil of revolutionary France.

productions.title: The Phantom of the Opera
productions.description: A haunting tale of passion, mystery, and obsession unfolds beneath the Paris Opera House. With its iconic music and breathtaking spectacle, The Phantom of the Opera remains one of the most mesmerizing musicals ever staged.

productions.title: Stranger Things, the First Shadow
productions.description: A journey back to Hawkins before the world turned upside down. This gripping stage prequel to the hit series reveals the origins of the darkness, blending supernatural mystery, cinematic spectacle, and thrilling storytelling.

productions.title: Harry Potter, and the Cursed Child
productions.description: Return to the wizarding world in an extraordinary theatrical adventure that continues Harry Potter's story. With breathtaking stage magic and a powerful new tale of friendship, legacy, and destiny, The Cursed Child is a spellbinding experience for fans and newcomers alike.

productions.title: Wicked
productions.description: Discover the untold story of the witches of Oz in this dazzling, award-winning musical. With unforgettable songs and a powerful story of friendship and identity, Wicked reveals how two unlikely friends became the Wicked Witch of the West and Glinda the Good.

productions.title: Oklahoma
productions.description: A vibrant celebration of love, community, and the pioneering spirit of the American frontier. Filled with unforgettable songs and lively storytelling, Oklahoma! is a joyful classic that continues to charm audiences around the world.

productions.title: Blood Brothers
productions.description: A powerful and emotional musical that tells the tragic story of twins separated at birth and raised in completely different worlds. Filled with unforgettable songs and gripping drama, Blood Brothers explores fate, class, and the bonds that can never truly be broken.

productions.title: The Waitress
productions.description: A heartfelt musical about dreams, friendship, and finding the courage to start again. Featuring a beautiful score by Sara Bareilles, Waitress follows a talented pie-maker searching for a fresh start and a slice of happiness.

productions.title: Priscilla
productions.description: A dazzling, high-energy musical adventure about friendship, identity, and self-expression. Packed with iconic pop hits, outrageous costumes, and spectacular performances, Priscilla is a joyful celebration that will have audiences dancing in their seats.
